name: get_products_by_query
description: Retrieves a list of products from Carrefour France based on a predefined query identifier. Returns product details including EAN, title, brand, category, images, and links. Useful for fetching curated product lists (e.g. bestsellers, promotions, themed selections) identified by a query ID.

query_id.description: The predefined query identifier (e.g. 'query_11836') that determines which product list to retrieve.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return per page (e.g. 20).
